name: 2.8.1 - Tempe pickups by themselves
notes: Tempe pickups by themselves: with Auto on the Tempe Orders page, Tempe pickups for today and tomorrow that aren't in COSTAR are entered by the RDP helper by itself, one at a time (pair the page once in Files & settings, Runs by itself). Open 7 days with Tempe's hours: Mon-Fri 7:00-18:30, Sat 7:00-17:30, Sun 8:00-15:30 (an hour before opening to 1.5 hours after closing). Update the RDP helper and the desk PC; upload testrun.html and discord.js too.
